Halftone Effect

Convert any photo into a vintage newspaper-style halftone dot print.

🖼️ Drop an image here or click to browse

Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Drop an image into the tool.
  2. Drag the dot-size slider to preview.
  3. Click Download PNG to save it.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does the halftone work?

The image is divided into a grid; each cell becomes a dot whose size matches the cell's average brightness.

What does the result look like?

Black dots on a white background, like classic print.

How do I control the look?

The dot-size slider sets the grid spacing from fine (4px) to chunky (24px).
